name: country-data
description: Compare countries on World Bank indicators, with charts, citations and data files.

interface.longDescription:
Research tool for students and analysts: compare countries on World Bank World Development Indicators and get the numbers, a chart and data files with citations.

Ask for 2 to 12 countries and 1 to 4 indicators over a year range: GDP, GDP per capita (PPP), inflation, population, unemployment, CO2 emissions, life expectancy, or any of about 1,500 indicator codes. Each country shows its latest value and the year of that value, the first value in the range, the change (percent for levels, percentage points for rates) and the compound annual growth rate. Years without a published value are listed and left empty; nothing is estimated or filled.

Rank countries on one indicator for a year, within a World Bank region or income group. Ties share a rank, aggregates are excluded, and countries without a value are listed separately. Leave the year out to use the latest year in which at least half of the countries have a value.

Downloads: an Excel workbook (summary, one sheet per indicator, long data sheet and a sources sheet), a CSV, and a PDF brief with line charts and APA-style citation lines for each indicator. The files hold the same values as the result.

Results name the source (World Bank, World Development Indicators, CC BY 4.0), the data's last update date and the retrieval time in UTC. Data is fetched live from api.worldbank.org and may be cached for up to 12 hours. Recent years are often not yet published. Taiwan and sub-national regions are not covered. Generated download links expire in about one hour.
defaultPrompt: Compare GDP per capita PPP for Germany, France, Italy and Spain from 2000 to 2024, with a chart and Excel file
Inflation and unemployment in Brazil, Mexico and Argentina, 2015-2024, with sources
Rank Sub-Saharan African countries by life expectancy, latest year

positive.prompt: Compare GDP per capita PPP for the United States, Germany, Japan, China and India from 2000 to 2024
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the latest value and year for each of the five countries, the 2000 value, the percent change and CAGR, a line chart, source and retrieval time, and Excel, CSV and PDF download links.

positive.prompt: Rank countries in Sub-Saharan Africa by life expectancy at birth, top 10
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the top 10 Sub-Saharan African countries by life expectancy for the latest well-covered year, the rule used to choose the year, the count of countries with and without data, the source, and Excel, CSV and PDF links.

positive.prompt: Which World Bank indicator code should I use for CO2 emissions per capita?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching World Development Indicators codes and names with the common CO2 per capita indicator listed first.

positive.prompt: Compare the Gini index and inflation for the United States, France, South Africa and Nigeria from 2010 to 2024
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the latest value and year for each country and indicator, the change in points or percentage points, and lists the years without data instead of filling them, with source and download links.

positive.prompt: Rank high-income countries by GDP per capita in current US dollars for 2023, top 3
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the top 3 high-income countries by GDP per capita for 2023, how many countries have no 2023 value, the source and retrieval time, and Excel, CSV and PDF links.

negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?
negative.description: Do not call a tool; this is general knowledge, not an indicator comparison.
Do not call a tool; the tools return published values and do not forecast.

negative.prompt: Convert 100 euros to US dollars at today's rate
negative.description: Do not call a tool; currency conversion is outside World Bank indicator comparison.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: country comparison on World Development Indicators with latest value per country, change and CAGR, rankings by region or income group, indicator search, and XLSX, CSV and PDF files with citations.

de-DE.subtitle: Länder mit Weltbank-Daten
de-DE.description: Vergleichen Sie 2 bis 12 Länder bei 1 bis 4 Indikatoren der Weltbank (World Development Indicators) über einen Zeitraum: BIP, BIP pro Kopf (KKP), Inflation, Bevölkerung, Arbeitslosigkeit, CO2, Lebenserwartung und rund 1.500 weitere. Je Land: letzter Wert mit Jahr, Veränderung und durchschnittliche jährliche Wachstumsrate. Fehlende Jahre bleiben leer und werden nicht geschätzt. Ranglisten nach Region oder Einkommensgruppe. Downloads: Excel mit Quellenblatt, CSV und PDF mit Diagrammen und Zitaten. Quelle: Weltbank, CC BY 4.0.

es-ES.subtitle: Países con datos del BM
es-ES.description: Compare de 2 a 12 países en 1 a 4 indicadores del Banco Mundial (World Development Indicators) a lo largo de varios años: PIB, PIB per cápita (PPA), inflación, población, desempleo, CO2, esperanza de vida y unos 1.500 más. Por país: último valor y su año, variación y tasa de crecimiento anual compuesta. Los años sin dato quedan vacíos y no se estiman. Clasificaciones por región o grupo de ingreso. Descargas: Excel con hoja de fuentes, CSV y PDF con gráficos y citas. Fuente: Banco Mundial, CC BY 4.0.

fr-FR.subtitle: Pays, données Banque mond.
fr-FR.description: Comparez 2 à 12 pays sur 1 à 4 indicateurs de la Banque mondiale (World Development Indicators) sur une période : PIB, PIB par habitant (PPA), inflation, population, chômage, CO2, espérance de vie et environ 1 500 autres. Pour chaque pays : dernière valeur et son année, variation et taux de croissance annuel composé. Les années sans donnée restent vides et ne sont pas estimées. Classements par région ou groupe de revenu. Téléchargements : Excel avec feuille des sources, CSV et PDF avec graphiques et citations. Source : Banque mondiale, CC BY 4.0.

ja-JP.subtitle: 世界銀行データで国を比較
ja-JP.description: 世界銀行の世界開発指標で2〜12か国を1〜4指標、期間を指定して比較します。GDP、1人当たりGDP（PPP）、インフレ率、人口、失業率、CO2、平均寿命など約1,500指標に対応。各国の最新値とその年、変化、年平均成長率を表示します。データのない年は空欄のままで推計しません。地域・所得グループ別のランキングも可能。ダウンロード：出典シート付きExcel、CSV、グラフと引用付きPDF。出典：世界銀行、CC BY 4.0。

pl-PL.subtitle: Kraje w danych Banku Św.
pl-PL.description: Porównuj od 2 do 12 krajów według 1 do 4 wskaźników Banku Światowego (World Development Indicators) w wybranym okresie: PKB, PKB na mieszkańca (PPP), inflacja, ludność, bezrobocie, CO2, długość życia i ok. 1500 innych. Dla każdego kraju: ostatnia wartość i jej rok, zmiana oraz średnioroczne tempo wzrostu. Lata bez danych pozostają puste i nie są szacowane. Rankingi według regionu lub grupy dochodowej. Pliki: Excel z arkuszem źródeł, CSV i PDF z wykresami oraz cytowaniami. Źródło: Bank Światowy, CC BY 4.0.

pt-BR.subtitle: Países com dados do BM
pt-BR.description: Compare de 2 a 12 países em 1 a 4 indicadores do Banco Mundial (World Development Indicators) ao longo de um período: PIB, PIB per capita (PPC), inflação, população, desemprego, CO2, expectativa de vida e cerca de 1.500 outros. Para cada país: último valor e o ano, variação e taxa de crescimento anual composta. Anos sem dado ficam vazios e não são estimados. Rankings por região ou grupo de renda. Downloads: Excel com aba de fontes, CSV e PDF com gráficos e citações. Fonte: Banco Mundial, CC BY 4.0.
